web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's July economic data showed a slowdown in key sectors. Retail sales grew by 0.6%, missing the expected 1.5% increase and decelerating from June's 1% growth. Urban fixed-asset investment contracted by 6.7%, worse than the estimated 6% decline. Industrial output rose by 4.5%, undershooting the anticipated 4.8% growth and slowing from June's 5.3% rise. Despite these figures, China's GDP growth for the first half of the year remains on track to meet the target range of 4.5%-5%.
